Jon Rahm Departs LIV Golf Circuit

Golfer Jon Rahm has announced his departure from the LIV Golf circuit. The move is described as a blow to the circuit, which is facing financial difficulties and is referred to as "embattled." One report indicates Rahm's decision followed an "unacceptable" offer, while another mentions his lawyers seeking an exit from an old contract.
